sources.title: Android Developers — Thermal API
sources.supports: Thermal state can limit sustained performance; applications can monitor it and adjust load.
sources.does_not_support: Any numerical A24 temperature threshold, RC constant, leakage slope, or energy calibration used in this experiment.

sources.title: Linux v6.7 — Power allocator governor tunables
sources.supports: A closed-loop thermal governor can use temperature error to control allowed power, which affects granted performance. All devices in a zone require a consistent power scale.
sources.does_not_support: A24 using this governor, a specific DVFS curve, or validation of the new simulator's physical parameters.
